ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, if all the grasses are removed, which species gets directly affected?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, with grass labeled “grasses” at the bottom, slightly to the right of the middle. Looking along the red arrows starting from “grasses”, one can see that one of the arrows points to a butterfly near above the grass. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate the direct relationship from food source to consumer. Therefore, if all grasses are removed, the species that directly depend on grasses will be directly affected; the corresponding one in the diagram is butterfly.
